observations: Photo 0: top view of a white games console with an XBOX logo printed on the top right and a perforated vent grid over half the lid; a black Xbox wireless controller lies on top.
Photo 0: part of a box with HDMI printed on it at the right edge, contents not shown.
Photo 1: front of the console showing a horizontal disc slot and the eject button, so it is the disc version, not the all-digital one; the black controller sits on top.
Photo 2: corner of the console with the Xbox sphere power button logo on the front face and the vent grid; no visible cracks.
White body, vent grid pattern and slim slot loading front match an Xbox One S.
No photo shows the console powered on, a screen, the storage label, the rear ports, the power cable or the bottom sticker.
Photos 1 and 2 carry a Jiji dealer watermark (Williams Gadgets).

read_from: photos 0 to 2 white vent grid body and photo 1 disc slot match the One S design; One S text itself is not read

claims.evidence: Photo 0 XBOX logo; the white perforated body in photos 0 to 2 and the disc slot in photo 1 match the One S with disc drive.
No storage label or Settings storage screen is shown; 500GB units look identical.
One black Xbox wireless controller is shown in photos 0, 1 and 2.
No screenshot of the games and apps list; installed games can also be tied to an account and not transfer.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have a fault (HDMI port, power supply, overheating).
risks.proof: A clip of the console booting to the home screen on a TV with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
A photo of the bottom label or a screenshot of Settings, System, Storage showing total capacity.

risks.risk: Disc drive may not read or eject discs.
risks.proof: A clip of a disc being inserted, read and ejected.

risks.risk: Controller may have stick drift or dead buttons, or not pair.
risks.proof: A clip of the controller navigating the console menu and both sticks moving.

risks.risk: Installed games may be digital licences tied to the seller's account and lost on reset.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the games and apps list and the account they belong to.

risks.risk: Power cable and HDMI cable may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the power cord and HDMI cable with the console.
risks.if_unproven: as console and controller only, no cables

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or banned from online play.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number on the bottom sticker matching the Settings, System, Console info screen.
risks.if_unproven: as offline only, flagged for serial check

proof_requests: Clip of the console booting to the home screen with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
Screenshot of Settings, System, Storage showing 1TB, or the bottom label.
Photo of the bottom sticker serial and the Console info screen.
Clip of a disc being read and the controller moving through menus.
Screenshot of the installed games list.
Photo of the rear ports and the power and HDMI cables.
response.reason: The XBOX logo and the white One S body with a disc slot are visible, so it can be priced as an Xbox One S at worst case: 500GB, not working, no games. Power on, storage and the controller test would raise it.
